name: promptmaster
description: Rewrites your rough draft into a clear prompt (pipeline or iterative) for you to review before sending. Never answers it, never auto-sends.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: auto picks pipeline or iterative for you. The band's Mode button overrides this for the session.

model.title: Rewrite model
model.description: Model used for the rewrite (alias or full id).

pipelineTemplate.title: Pipeline template
pipelineTemplate.description: Output format for long or big tasks. Use plain section lines.
pipelineTemplate.default:
Goal: <one sentence>
Context: <what the AI needs to know>
Deliverables: <exact files or outputs expected, with format>
Steps: <ordered pipeline: 1. plan, 2. build, 3. check, 4. deliver>
Constraints: <what to do and what to avoid>
Done when: <checkable success criteria>
Questions: <anything unclear that the AI must ask me first>

iterativeTemplate.title: Iterative template
iterativeTemplate.description: Output format for short follow-ups. Keep it short.
iterativeTemplate.default:
Goal: <the one change wanted>
Scope: <what to touch and what to leave alone>
Check: <how I will know it worked>
(Whole answer under 5 lines.)
